items.question: Do I need experience to apply?
items.answer: No. We welcome newly certified PSWs and provide onboarding support and role matching.

items.question: Do you offer live-in or 24-hour support roles?
items.answer: Yes. Some of our home care placements include live-in or extended-hour support positions.

items.question: Can I choose between rural and urban placements?
items.answer: Yes. We work with facilities in both major cities and underserved rural communities.

items.question: What if I don’t have access to a car?
items.answer: Travel support and local matching is available. We work with your transportation needs.

items.question: Do you have bilingual PSW roles?
items.answer: Yes. We often recruit bilingual PSWs, especially in Ontario, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing connects personal support workers with fulfilling healthcare and home support roles across Canada. We offer flexible work, supportive environments, and travel-ready opportunities for PSWs at all experience levels.
